div.div: DUAL WORKSPACE ARCHITECTURE: Native GCP audit sharing is configured once in Admin Console (Account settings → Legal & compliance → Sharing options → GCP). It streams logins and admin events directly through the org sink into Pub/Sub with zero polling. Domain-wide delegation is used when native sharing cannot be enabled or for directory user/group queries.
